# EWS creation TODO links leave offline policy and message flags unresolved

The follow-up adds 2026215 beside the offline-storage-policy TODO and 2026218 beside the draft/read/MAPI-flag questions. The executable path remains unchanged: C++ attaches and commits the database header before attempting its offline copy, and Rust still sets MSGFLAG_READ before its draft branch. The links track unresolved work; they do not implement the requested checks or prove Exchange server semantics. The earlier creation extraction and its error channels are separate changes.

Scope: Exchange message creation follow-up comments.
